cookies.description: Cookies injected before capture. Each item needs name, value, and domain (or url).
cookies.title: Cookies

delayMs.description: Extra pause after load for late animations or lazy images.
delayMs.title: Extra delay (ms)

devicePreset.description: Pick a device viewport, or choose Custom to use your own dimensions below.
devicePreset.title: Device preset

deviceScaleFactor.description: Pixel ratio for high-DPI captures. Used only when the device preset is Custom.
deviceScaleFactor.title: Device scale factor

displayHeaderFooter.description: Render a header and footer on every PDF page using the templates below.
displayHeaderFooter.title: Header and footer

footerTemplate.description: HTML for the PDF footer. Supports <span class="pageNumber"> and <span class="totalPages">.
footerTemplate.title: Footer template (HTML)

fullPage.description: Capture the entire scrollable page, not just the viewport. Always on for PDFs.
fullPage.title: Full page

headerTemplate.description: HTML for the PDF header. Supports <span class="pageNumber"> and <span class="totalPages">.
headerTemplate.title: Header template (HTML)

headers.description: Custom request headers sent with every page load, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}.
headers.title: Extra HTTP headers

jpegQuality.description: Only used when the output format is JPEG.
jpegQuality.title: JPEG quality

outputFormat.description: Screenshot as PNG/JPEG image, or a print-ready PDF document.
outputFormat.title: Output format

pdfFormat.title: Paper size
pdfFormat.description: Paper size for the PDF document.

pdfLandscape.title: Landscape orientation
pdfLandscape.description: Render the PDF in landscape orientation.

pdfMargin.description: Margin applied to all four sides, e.g. 0.4in or 10mm.
pdfMargin.title: Page margin

printBackground.description: Include CSS backgrounds and colors in the PDF.
printBackground.title: Print backgrounds

sectionPdf.sectionCaption: PDF options (only when output format is PDF)
sectionPdf.title: PDF options

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for a single page to load.
timeoutMs.title: Page timeout (ms)

urls.description: One or more public http(s) URLs. Each URL is rendered in a real Chromium browser and captured. Internal/private addresses are blocked.
urls.title: URLs to capture

viewportHeight.description: Used only when the device preset is Custom.
viewportHeight.title: Viewport height (px)

viewportWidth.description: Used only when the device preset is Custom.
viewportWidth.title: Viewport width (px)

waitUntil.description: How long to wait for the page to settle before capturing.
waitUntil.title: Wait until
